direction_rule: two failed states, best of legal repeated drops, exceeds max(0.1% initial loss, 5% baseline drop); positive if baseline has no drop
recovery_rule: new pass, or >=20% lower failed-arm scaled parameter error without >0.2 pp holdout display loss, or equal pass with >=20% fewer cameras; no loss/regression of any passing baseline
gpu_timing: Unavailable for individual synchronous editor Camera.Render calls; no derived GPU timing.
